title: Frank & Atticus – Baked Apple Custard 100ml
description:
Frank & Atticus – Baked Apple Custard 100ml
Frank & Atticus’ new Baked Apple Custard is a perfect combination of caramelized apple, toasty cinnamon, and velvety custard. This delectable dessert vape will have you returning to the kitchen for another helping.
From the start, you’ll detect just the proper amount of baked apple, along with brown sugar and cinnamon undertones. Warm vanilla bean unites all of these flavours, which is followed by a smooth sweet custard finish. It doesn’t get much better than this when it comes to comfort food as a vape!
Frank & Atticus vape juices come in 100ml bottles with 0MG nicotine. If you love dessert e-liquids, the Frank & Atticus juice range is a must-try!
